findings.title: indoorLighting is pushed before the furniture, so its edgeThing lamp resolves last and can warn
findings.detail: In PushRoom, stack.Push("indoorLighting", rp) sits before the Workshop/Kitchen/Hospital/Library switch, so the StandingLamp edgeThing resolves after every bench, bed and bookcase. EdgeThing.CanResolve fails when no standable edge cell is left that wouldn't wipe a building, and BaseGen.Resolve then logs "Could not find any RuleDef for symbol edgeThing". That's unlikely in a 5x5 part but possible. Move the indoorLighting push to after the switch so the lamp resolves first; the furniture already carries skipSingleThingIfHasToWipeBuildingOrDoesntFit and will skip silently.

findings.title: Throne room pieces wipe what is in their way
findings.detail: SymbolResolver_Interior_ThroneRoom pushes the throne, braziers and drape through "thing" without the skip flag, so they wipe rather than skip. They resolve first in an empty part, so this is harmless here; it would only matter if something were placed in that part beforehand.
